beats.idea: Barter stalls when the seller rejects grain
beats.relation_note: Show refusal within the attempted exchange, then a question mark beside the shoes.
beats.shows: Seller rejects grain; shoes remain beside question mark.
beats.template_note: Buyer holds grain; seller holds shoes. On 'देकर', buyer extends grain towards seller without completing transfer. On 'नहीं', seller shakes head and a cross lands on grain. On 'कैसे', a question mark appears beside shoes; neither good changes hands.

beats.idea: Wheat exchanged for cloth; 8 kg remains
beats.shows: Farmer exchanges wheat for cloth; remaining wheat visible.
beats.template_note: On '10 kg', appear wheat held by farmer, tagged 10 kg. On '2 kg', separate a 2 kg portion, leaving the rest beside farmer. On 'देकर', give that portion from farmer to cloth seller, tagged 2 kg. On '1 metre', give cloth from seller to farmer, tagged 1 metre. On '8 kg', label remaining wheat 8 kg; keep received cloth visible beside farmer.

beats.idea: Barter is direct exchange without money
beats.relation_note: Direct reciprocal goods/services arrows contrast with a crossed-out intervening money route.
beats.shows: Goods/services swap directly; intervening money is crossed out.
beats.template_note: Appear participants holding generic goods with service symbols alongside; give goods in opposite directions and move service symbols directly between participants. At 'बिना', reveal money between them and refuse it, leaving direct arrows visible.

beats.idea: Selling for money then buying is not barter
beats.relation_note: Two successive transactions connect wheat to money and money to cloth; cross the barter classification, not the money.
beats.shows: Wheat sells; money buys cloth; barter label crossed.
beats.template_note: Hold wheat with the central trader and money with the wheat buyer; give wheat to that buyer and money to the trader. Give money from trader to a separate cloth seller and cloth back to trader. At 'नहीं', cross the short 'barter' classification tag. Keep the two counterparties visibly separate.

beats.idea: Direct exchange identifies barter
beats.relation_note: Opposing direct arrows connect the two participants without an intermediate payment node.
beats.shows: Goods/services travel directly between two participants.
beats.template_note: Appear two participants with generic goods and service symbols; give goods in opposite directions and move service symbols directly to the other participant. Keep both paths direct.

beats.idea: No money, but cloth is paid for
beats.relation_note: Cross money at its denial; wheat and cloth visibly exchange.
beats.shows: Money crossed; wheat pays for cloth.
beats.template_note: Appear money, wheat and cloth; refuse money on 'नहीं'; show wheat held by buyer and cloth by seller; give wheat to seller on 'wheat', then cloth to buyer.

beats.idea: Services can also be bartered
beats.relation_note: Repair work and grain payment form a service-for-goods exchange.
beats.shows: Repairer fixes bicycle; owner hands over grain.
beats.template_note: Appear bicycle and grain with owner; hold repair tools with repairer; move tools to bicycle on 'ठीक'; transform broken bicycle into repaired bicycle; give grain from owner to repairer on 'exchange'.

beats.idea: Both parties decide the exchange value
beats.relation_note: Questions about wheat and cloth quantities resolve through both parties' assent, not seller authority alone.
beats.shows: Wheat, cloth, quantity questions; both parties agree.
beats.template_note: Appear wheat and cloth between buyer and seller; show question marks on their quantity tags; show assent bubbles on both people at 'दोनों की हाँ'; compare their two assent bubbles side by side at 'अकेला seller नहीं'.

beats.idea: An agreed ratio is only illustrative
beats.relation_note: Compare the agreed quantities, visibly scoped to this exchange rather than a universal rate.
beats.shows: Two-kilogram wheat swaps with one-metre cloth.
beats.template_note: Partners offer wheat tagged '2 kg' and cloth tagged '1 metre', assent and swap. Keep the ratio inside their agreement grouping; add 'illustrative' at 'illustrative' and cross a 'fixed rate' tag at 'नहीं'.

beats.idea: Barter covers goods and services without money
beats.relation_note: Group wheat–cloth exchange and repair-for-grain exchange under barter; cross money beside the wheat–cloth exchange.
beats.shows: Goods swap and repair-for-grain grouped as barter.
beats.template_note: Give wheat and cloth in opposite directions between goods partners; refuse money at 'नहीं'; reveal a second branch with repairer holding tools and service recipient giving grain at 'repair के बदले अनाज'; group both branches under barter.

beats.idea: Direct, moneyless, mutually agreed exchange
beats.relation_note: Two parties exchange directly, with money excluded and assent shown on both sides.
beats.shows: Direct swap, crossed money, two assent ticks.
beats.template_note: Give the two generic exchange items directly between partners on 'exchange'; refuse money on 'बिना'; show an assent bubble with a tick on each partner at 'दोनों की हाँ'. No specific commodity is introduced.

beats.idea: Barter survives from early civilizations to today
beats.shows: Early barter timeline reaches neighbors swapping goods today
beats.template_note: Appear: neighbors holding generic goods bundles with a question mark beside their exchange. On 'हाँ', replace the question mark with a tick. On 'early civilizations', reveal the earlier timeline endpoint with repeated barter symbols and label 'Common in early civilizations'. On 'आज', reveal the present endpoint labeled 'Limited informal exchanges'; give each neighbor's bundle to the other.

beats.idea: Matching needs enable a moneyless swap
beats.shows: Matching wants lead to goods swapping without money
beats.template_note: Each neighbor holds a different generic bundle. At ask, thought bubbles show the other neighbor's bundle; ticks indicate matching wants. On 'बिना', cross out the money icon between them. On 'swap', exchange the bundles directly.

beats.idea: Money and barter can coexist
beats.shows: Money appears; barter remains beside it
beats.template_note: Keep the barter symbol visible. Appear: money beside it on 'पैसा'. On 'मिटा नहीं', retain barter at full visibility. On 'दोनों साथ', group both inside one shared frame; do not transform barter into money.

beats.idea: Barter was common, now limited
beats.shows: Many earlier barter symbols; few present barter symbols
beats.template_note: A qualitative historical comparison, not an exchange process: show many barter symbols at the earlier endpoint and few at today's endpoint, without numerical counts.

beats.idea: इच्छा न मिले तो barter असफल
beats.shows: पहला wheat ठुकराए; दूसरा कपड़ा देकर स्वीकारे।
beats.template_note: appear: किसान के पास wheat, tag '2 kg'; sellers के पास cloth, tag '1 metre'। show_text: पहले seller की चाह में oil का चित्र। hold: किसान wheat आगे करे। refuse: 'मना' पर पहले seller द्वारा wheat पर cross। show_text: दूसरे seller की चाह में wheat का चित्र। accept: 'मान' पर wheat पर tick। give: किसान से दूसरे seller को 2 kg wheat और वापस किसान को 1 metre cloth।

beats.idea: दोनों की जरूरत एक साथ मिले
beats.shows: दोनों चाहें: मेल; केवल एक चाहे: असफल।
beats.template_note: appear: दो traders, प्रत्येक के पास अलग neutral वस्तु; wheat या cloth जैसे पिछले उदाहरण न जोड़ें। show_text: प्रत्येक की thought bubble में दूसरे की वस्तु का चित्र। compare: दोनों पारस्परिक इच्छाओं वाले दृश्य के सामने केवल एक तरफ इच्छा वाला दृश्य। accept: पहले दृश्य में exchange की संभावना पर tick। refuse: 'काफी नहीं' पर एकतरफा दृश्य के बीच cross। छोटे label: 'दोनों की जरूरत' और 'सिर्फ एक तरफ'।

beats.idea: पैसा बिक्री और खरीद अलग करता है
beats.shows: Wheat बिके; पैसा मिले; पैसे से कपड़ा।
beats.template_note: appear: wheat seller, wheat buyer और अलग cloth seller। give: 'बेचें' पर wheat seller से buyer को wheat तथा buyer से seller को money। accept: money पर tick। move: वही money wheat seller के साथ cloth seller की ओर। give: 'खरीदें' पर money cloth seller को और cloth खरीदार को। show_text: cloth seller की bubble में wheat का चित्र; refuse: 'नहीं चाहिए' पर उस bubble के wheat पर cross, स्वीकार किए money पर नहीं। रकम न जोड़ें।

beats.idea: अलग अनुपात और अविभाज्य गाय
beats.shows: Wheat-कपड़ा तय; गाय का अनुपात और विभाजन अनिश्चित।
beats.template_note: appear: wheat tag '2 kg' और cloth tag '1 metre'। compare: दोनों के बीच बराबरी का चिह्न। appear: 'गाय' पर पूरी गाय; उसके exchange ratio के लिए प्रश्नचिह्न, कोई संख्या नहीं। show_text: 'छोटी खरीद' का छोटा label। 'बाँटेंगे कैसे?' पर अखंड गाय के पास विभाजन का प्रश्नचिह्न उभरे; गाय को काटते हुए न दिखाएँ।

beats.idea: स्थिर भुगतान की बदलती क्रय-शक्ति
beats.shows: अनाज वही; कपड़े की क्रय-शक्ति आधी।
beats.template_note: give: lender से borrower को cloth, tag '2 metres'। appear: दोनों के बीच promise slip, 'बाद में: 10 kg अनाज, तय quality'। move: 'बाद में' पर अगले समय-स्थान में जाएँ। give: 'लौटाया' पर borrower से lender को grain, tag '10 kg'; तय quality tag बनाए रखें। compare: पहले के 2 metres cloth और अब उसी 10 kg grain से मिलने वाले 1 metre cloth को 'तब'/'बाद में' slots में रखें। दोनों slots में grain का 10 kg tag समान रहे; वास्तविक दूसरी cloth खरीद न दिखाएँ।

beats.idea: Barter में मूल्य, विभाजन, संग्रह और repayment की मुश्किलें
beats.relation_note: चार जोड़ियाँ: अलग ratios से साझा माप का अभाव; गाय का न बँटना; अनाज सड़ना; समान repayment मात्रा से कम सामान।
beats.shows: अलग अनुपात; अखंड गाय; सड़ता अनाज; घटता सामान
beats.template_note: क्रम: appear अलग अनुपात वाले तराजू; show_text साझा माप पर '?'; appear अखंड गाय, 'न बाँट पाना' पर विभाजन-चिह्न पर cross; transform ताजा अनाज into सड़ा अनाज; compare पहले और बाद में समान repayment मात्रा; appear बाद वाली मात्रा के सामने कम सामान। गाय को काटते न दिखाएँ।

beats.idea: उधार का monetary record मूल्य की गारंटी नहीं
beats.relation_note: उधार लिखने की सुविधा बनाम अनिश्चित purchasing power; फिर जरूरतों का मिलना बनाम मात्रा पर सहमति।
beats.shows: उधार दर्ज; सामान अनिश्चित; जरूरतें और मात्राएँ अलग
beats.template_note: appear पैसा और बहीखाता; show_text बहीखाते में 'उधार ₹…'; compare पैसा और सामान, सामान की मात्रा पर '?'। 'जरूरतें' पर दोनों विनिमयकर्ताओं के thought bubbles में दूसरे की वस्तु; 'quantities' पर उन्हीं वस्तुओं के ढेर अलग खाँचे में, बीच में सहमति का '?'। कोई भुगतान या swap न कराएँ।

beats.idea: Barter की कठिनाइयाँ matching से repayment तक
beats.relation_note: यह कठिनाइयों के विस्तार का सार है, सफल विनिमय की प्रक्रिया नहीं।
nouns: बाद में लौटाई जाने वाली वस्तुएँ
beats.shows: जरूरतों पर प्रश्न से repayment पर प्रश्न
beats.template_note: Matching और repayment प्रक्रिया के सिरों का उल्लेख हैं। स्थिर तीर-पंक्ति में दोनों व्यक्तियों की वस्तु-जरूरतों पर प्रश्नचिह्न और अंत में लौटाई जाने वाली वस्तुओं पर प्रश्नचिह्न दिखाएँ; narration कोई वास्तविक swap नहीं बताता।

beats.idea: Barter first; payment methods evolve
beats.shows: Money crossed; wheat–cloth exchanged; first gallery stage highlighted.
beats.template_note: Show wheat and cloth held by their traders. At “पैसा”, reveal money between them; at “नहीं”, cross it. At “barter”, exchange wheat and cloth directly and highlight stage 1. Do not add wants or dialogue. At “बदलाव”, emphasize the existing gallery’s progression arrows.

beats.idea: Salt enables an indirect exchange
beats.shows: Wheat buys salt; salt then buys cloth.
beats.template_note: hold farmer wheat; hold salt seller salt; give farmer→salt seller wheat tagged 2 kg; give salt seller→farmer salt tagged 1 kg; hold cloth seller cloth; give farmer→cloth seller the same salt; give cloth seller→farmer cloth tagged 1 metre. Keep salt unconsumed between exchanges.

beats.idea: Commodity money bridges buyers and sellers
beats.shows: Salt bridges exchange; cattle and shells join.
beats.template_note: appear salt between wheat and cloth with connecting arrows; appear stage 2 COMMODITY MONEY with salt, cattle and shells; hold cloth seller salt beside cloth, leaving wheat outside the seller’s exchange. No refusal cross: wheat need not be wanted, not necessarily rejected.

beats.idea: Standard coins pay and leave a remainder
beats.shows: Two coins buy grain; three coins remain.
beats.template_note: appear five matching silver coins at buyer, marked same weight and purity without invented measurements; give buyer→grain seller two coins; give grain seller→buyer grain tagged 5 kg; show_text on remaining coins 3; appear stage 3 METALLIC MONEY with gold and silver coins. No change-money return.

beats.idea: Standard metal coins also have material value
beats.shows: Matching durable coins sit inside commodity-money grouping.
beats.template_note: appear matching coins sequentially without a numerical total; show_text beside coins टिकाऊ and बराबर माप; show_text on gold and silver coins अपना material value; reveal their metallic-money group inside a larger commodity-money enclosure.

beats.idea: Notes pay at denomination and return change
beats.shows: ₹500 pays; goods and ₹200 return.
beats.template_note: Buyer pays ₹500 note, seller gives goods priced ₹300 and returns ₹200. Expand stage 4 PAPER MONEY; highlight the note’s printed ₹500 denomination, not its paper material.

beats.idea: Light notes avoid carrying heavy metal
beats.shows: Light note contrasts with heavy metal pile.
beats.template_note: A static side-by-side weight comparison explains carrying convenience; no specific transfer or amount is narrated.

beats.idea: Cheque transfers existing bank deposits
beats.shows: Cheque settles; payer falls, shopkeeper rises equally.
beats.template_note: appear stage 5 BANK MONEY with bank, cheque and deposit accounts; show payer ₹10,000 and shopkeeper ₹2,000; show_text cheque ₹1,500; move cheque into bank; move ₹1,500 deposit tag payer account→shopkeeper account; meter payer 10000→8500 and shopkeeper 2000→3500 simultaneously. Keep combined deposits ₹12,000 unchanged; show no new money appearing.

beats.idea: Electronic instructions transfer account money
beats.shows: QR payment shifts ₹300 between account balances.
beats.template_note: Show buyer account ₹2,000 and shopkeeper account ₹5,000; move buyer phone to QR code and back; show phone ₹300 paid and shopkeeper phone ₹300 received; move electronic ₹300 instruction between accounts; meter buyer 2000→1700 and shopkeeper 5000→5300 simultaneously. Reveal stage 6 DIGITAL MONEY with UPI phone, net banking screen and cards; compare electronic instruction with stationary paper money, which does not change hands.

beats.idea: Easier matching and transfer, not money creation
beats.shows: Intermediary connects parties; deposits transfer, total stays unchanged.
beats.template_note: appear sender, receiver and intermediary; move intermediary between parties at 'matching'; appear UPI phone and both deposit accounts at 'UPI'; move an existing deposit portion from sender account into receiver account at 'भेजता'; show_text on the encompassing deposit group: 'कुल deposits unchanged' at 'नहीं'. No new deposit pile appears.

beats.idea: Forms coexist; cards need not store money
beats.shows: Forms coexist; card accesses deposits outside the card.
beats.template_note: No payment process is narrated. Retain the gallery forms together; below, show a card linked to separate bank deposits, labelled 'हर card में stored नहीं', without crossing out the card.

beats.idea: Six-stage evolution of money
beats.shows: Six numbered forms highlight successively along book arrows.
beats.template_note: Use the book’s existing numbered illustrations and arrows. Move a highlight through barter, commodity, metallic, paper, bank and digital on their exact spoken words; keep every preceding form visible. Do not animate barter transactions.

beats.idea: Where payment value comes from
beats.shows: Salt ₹20; note ₹500; question marks above.
beats.template_note: Appear salt packet and note with question marks; show_text ₹20 on salt at ₹20 and ₹500 on note at ₹500; accept each as payment at its payment clause.

beats.idea: Usefulness survives loss of monetary acceptance
beats.shows: Payment crossed; useful salt remains; paper lacks ₹500.
beats.template_note: Refuse salt as payment at बंद; retain salt with usefulness and resale ticks. Compare note paper with ₹500 using ≠ at नहीं; cross a redemption-promise tag at नहीं है. Do not cross the valid note’s purchasing power.

beats.idea: Material versus external backing
beats.shows: Gold itself; note beside trust and stamped law.

beats.idea: Nonmonetary utility is not purchasing power
beats.shows: Salt enters cooking; paper differs from valid note.
beats.template_note: Move salt into cooking pot at खाना बनाने; retain a resale tick when monetary use is removed. Compare paper’s negligible material value with the valid note’s intact purchasing-power tick at nil.

beats.idea: Commodity objects versus monetary claims
beats.shows: Commodity objects opposite notes, balances, digital claims.
beats.template_note: Appear each named example at its spoken cue in the corresponding column. At claim connect the account balance to the bank with a payment-claim tag, not a physical stock of goods.

beats.idea: Acceptance depends on onward spendability
beats.shows: Salt refused outside; rupees travel to next shop.
beats.template_note: Accept salt locally; refuse salt with outside seller at मना. Show outside seller’s thought bubble of onward buyers refusing salt at नहीं लेते. Accept rupees at लेता, then give them from that seller to the next shop seller at दूसरी दुकान.

beats.idea: Small payments without cutting notes
beats.shows: Indivisible cow, heavy salt; small payment, intact note.
beats.template_note: Compare whole cow and carried salt load with a small payment amount. Show a cut-line overlay on the intact note, then refuse that interpretation at नहीं; never depict cutting as monetary divisibility.

beats.idea: Money examples versus payment route
beats.shows: Coins, bullion opposite notes, balance; UPI routes amount.
beats.template_note: Appear examples in two groups; attach weight and purity tags to bullion. At भेजने move an unnumbered amount marker from the bank balance along the UPI route; do not create a separate UPI balance.

beats.idea: Legal backing and practical payment properties
beats.shows: Stamped tender clears debt; durability differs across forms.
beats.template_note: Place stamped law beside tender; give tender from payer to creditor and mark debt settled at चुकाता. Connect trusted money to onward shop spending. Move a small payment toward the distant shop. Compare durable commodities, damaged paper and digital display connected to technology at their spoken cues.

beats.idea: Four limits to simplified money comparisons
beats.shows: Prices fluctuate; redemption crossed; blocked access preserves balance.
beats.template_note: Meter commodity price up and down without invented values. Compare authority backing with gold redemption using ≠ at नहीं. Show coin with intrinsic-value question mark at हर coin. Close the account access gate at रुकना while leaving its balance unchanged at मिटना नहीं.

beats.idea: Utility differs from money; commodities can deteriorate
beats.shows: Utility ≠ monetary value; sick cattle, damp salt.
beats.template_note: Show utility ≠ monetary value above the named commodities. Transform healthy cattle into visibly sick cattle at बीमार; move moisture into salt and transform it into damp clumped salt at बिगड़ता.

beats.idea: Payment salt also has cooking value
beats.shows: Grain swaps for salt; salt enters cooking pot.
beats.template_note: Appear: salt as the payment object. At 'grain', seller gives grain to buyer. At '2 packets', buyer gives exactly two salt packets to seller. At 'आगे न चलें', show a question mark beside an onward-payment arrow from the packets. At 'खाना बनाएगा', move salt from a packet into the seller’s cooking pot.

beats.idea: Commodity money has nonmonetary value
beats.shows: Salt as money beside salt used in cooking

beats.idea: Usefulness and purchasing power alone are insufficient
beats.shows: Commodity needs payment tick; note's commodity classification crossed
beats.template_note: Appear useful commodity with payment question mark at 'Useful'; show payment tick at 'चलना चाहिए'; appear note with purchasing-power tag at 'purchasing power'; cross its 'commodity money' classification at 'नहीं', not the note's payment validity.

beats.idea: Commodity remains useful outside payment
beats.shows: Same commodity: payment value and nonpayment usefulness

beats.idea: Salt’s regions versus cattle-keeping communities
beats.shows: Salt beside map; cattle beside pastoral keepers
beats.template_note: Historical usage is located, not enacted as a transaction.

beats.idea: Cowries worked through acceptance across regions
beats.shows: Palm-sized cowries; three regions; accepting people nod
beats.template_note: Show cowries first; on स्वीकार, people nod and a tick appears on the shells. Pair them with the three named map regions; do not invent a payment amount.

beats.idea: Compressed tea and dried tobacco in their regions
beats.shows: Tea brick mapped; building brick crossed; tobacco mapped
beats.image_wanted: compressed tea brick dried tobacco leaves
beats.template_note: appear compressed tea brick at चाय; compare tea brick and construction brick at बनाने; refuse construction brick at नहीं; appear Central Asia and Tibet map markers at Central; appear dried tobacco leaves beside Colonial America map at Tobacco. The opening question does not specify a manufacturing process, so do not invent one.

beats.idea: Three quantities have equal assumed value
beats.shows: Bazaar: farmer wants cloth; three equal-value goods.

beats.idea: Salt bridges grain and cloth exchanges
beats.shows: Grain exchanged for salt, then salt for cloth.
beats.template_note: In order: hold farmer's 10 kg grain and salt trader's 2 kg salt; give grain from farmer to salt trader; give salt from salt trader to farmer; hold cloth seller's 2 metres cloth; give all salt from farmer to cloth seller; give cloth from cloth seller to farmer. Keep quantity tags on moving goods; finish with farmer holding only cloth and zero grain or salt.

beats.idea: Salt removes the matching-wants requirement
beats.shows: Salt passes onward; cloth requirement crossed out.
beats.template_note: hold(buyer,salt); give(buyer,farmer,salt) at 'लिया'; move(salt,onward recipient) to illustrate 'आगे चलने'; appear(cloth) beside buyer at 'कपड़ा'; refuse(cloth) at 'नहीं'. Label the crossed cloth 'देना जरूरी नहीं', distinguishing no requirement from refusal of cloth.

beats.idea: Commodities have uses beyond payment
beats.shows: Salt seasons food; cattle, tea, tobacco show uses.
beats.template_note: appear(salt) and appear(food) at 'salt'; move(salt,food,into=true) at 'खाने'; appear(cattle) at 'cattle' with short livelihood tag at 'रोज़ी'; appear(tea) at 'tea'; appear(tobacco) at 'tobacco'; show_text on tea and tobacco: 'अलग demand' at 'demand'.

beats.idea: Use plus local acceptance enables exchange
beats.shows: Community accepts commodities; coins follow on timeline.
beats.template_note: appear(commodity money) with 'अपना उपयोग' tag; appear(community members) as a bounded group at 'community'; accept(commodity money,community members) at 'acceptance'; give commodity between members at 'आसान'; show_text on group boundary 'इसी community में' at 'हर जगह नहीं'. At 'पहले', compare commodity money and metallic coins along a before–later arrow, labelling coins 'बाद में common'.
